pass.description: true when every cell of `invariants` is "pass", false when any is "fail".

reasoning.description: What the rubric asks for under "Your reasoning". On a fail it is shown to the agent that wrote the code.

invariants.description: Your verdict on the two questions, one entry for every <invariant> above and for no other, keyed by its id.

code.description: Question 1 for this invariant. "pass" when it lists no <code>: that half is not judged here.

tests.description: Question 2 for this invariant. "pass" when it lists no <test>: that half is not judged here.
